acceptance: skills/blog in the catalog source names benchbox-site drafts/STYLE_GUIDE.md and drafts/VOICE_REFERENCE.md and no _blog/ path
make skill-sync in core leaves the synced blog skill matching the source
context: Found 2026-10-17 by grepping the skill catalog source for _blog/ after the core site removal (#3096, 364a6e9cd). Catalog source rev at check: 8b7752c.
description:
The blog skill tells agents to read `_blog/STYLE_GUIDE.md` and `_blog/VOICE_REFERENCE.md` (~/Developer/skill-sync-skills skills/blog/SKILL.md:14, synced into BenchBox .claude/skills/blog/SKILL.md:14). Core no longer has _blog/: it moved to benchbox-site as drafts/ (drafts/STYLE_GUIDE.md and drafts/VOICE_REFERENCE.md exist there). In a core checkout the skill silently falls back to the global ~/.claude/blog guides, so posts are written against the wrong voice rules. skills/blog/references/draft.md:3 also assumes `{series}/drafts/{slug}.md` under _blog/.

Update the skill source to name the site repo's drafts/ guides, then run `make skill-sync` in core.
